headline: AmCham China Urges Working-Level Talks Between US and Beijing
summary: The president of the American Chamber of Commerce in China called on Washington and Beijing to conduct more working-level negotiations to establish long-term stability for foreign businesses beyond summit meetings.
why: AmCham China represents hundreds of U.S. multinational companies operating in mainland China. Regulatory clarity and diplomatic predictability directly affect foreign direct investment and corporate supply chains.

impacts.name: China
impacts.why: Institutionalized working-level bilateral talks could stabilize operating conditions for foreign businesses.
